rules: Inspect audit role/source references first; return only train, historical dev or aggregate-only natural_dev_proposed rows with no test role/reference. Hold unknown roles without exposing content.
Read test-role metadata only to hash exact type strings and collect existing document IDs. Do not open test_items.csv or regenerate the mixed review audit.

Bind train and historical dev to file + one-based CSV record + complete source-row hash; verify the four-field content hash against the audit. Natural dev starts at the saved audit export, retaining original source references.
Keep all 62 proposed natural dev candidates as the qualification pool without quotas; historical dev remains reference only. Reserve all their types/documents even when a candidate is held.
Keep stored candidates and labels. Apply only explicit, content-linked Shaked decisions; no gold insertion, candidate repair, semantic aliasing or type merging.

Compute a target only for a unique length-preserving quote-folded match bounded by non-word characters; hold attached/embedded boundaries and repeated matches unless a saved human span resolves them. Preserve sentence and exact raw span including approved prefixes. A letter immediately outside a surrounding quote is also an ambiguous boundary; do not silently omit it.

Reuse sentence/type/label/document-matched Knesset human review, attributed to Ben by Shaked; a clean flag or note alone is insufficient evidence. Shaked review is disclosed as AI-assisted, not a second blind annotation.

Hold missing document provenance, unresolved/adverse human decisions, ambiguous spans, invalid candidate contracts and all duplicate text groups within a split. No duplicate is preferred by label or model performance.

Block exact reserved type/document matches in train and dev, and block training against all historical/proposed dev types, documents and text. No automatic document aliases or linguistic type-family normalization.
Pair-loss inputs require at least two distinct candidates and exactly one trimmed positive under the unchanged encoder contract. Otherwise-qualified singleton dev is prediction/descriptive only.
Write stable sorted CSVs and a manifest with source/code/output hashes, counts and applied decisions. No clock-dependent fields or repeated LLM calls.

Local AI semantic/target proposals bind exact saved input hashes and remain held until a recorded explicit Shaked approval; approved candidate replacements replace an existing entry, never add gold to pass a check.

Apply only the explicitly approved exact dr/bdr split separation: otherwise eligible train ד״ר is held when בד״ר is reserved for dev. Do not strip prefixes, merge types or change labels/candidates/targets; existing holds remain unchanged.
limits: Reproduction begins with retained exports and decisions; it does not reconstruct original Internet mining or original API responses.
Technical qualification does not independently establish every training label or negative candidate as correct. Historical declared AI model names are preserved, not verified.
Development is a small curated Knesset sample; historical human review is reused where content matches. No new blind annotation, inter-annotator agreement or model performance was measured.

Overlap guarantees concern exact stored type/document IDs, the explicitly approved dr/bdr separation pair, and authorized train/dev duplicate text only. No test text was inspected for duplicates; other document aliases, prefix families and pretraining exposure are not resolved.
Unknown-role audit rows remain inaccessible; missing source-to-audit membership stops export. Missing document provenance is held.
Preparation readiness is subject to project-manager review. Model tokenization/length limits and Colab training belong to the next package.

The approved Rambam interpretation accepts a linguistic expansion of the proper name even when the sentence refers to the hospital or street. This bounded clarification is not a general entity/etymology policy and is disclosed separately from historical referent labeling.
